info.title: Preve API
info.description: Google sign-in sessions, PDF analysis and user-initiated read-only Google Calendar import. Account-owned contacts and meeting contact links.

parameters.name: X-AI-Consent
parameters.description: Explicit consent to send the PDF to OpenAI for meeting preparation. Independent of Google login notice.

file.description: One PDF, maximum 20 MiB and 100 pages; encrypted or invalid PDFs rejected.

202.description: Document accepted; analysis may still be queued

200.description: Up to 100 newest documents owned by the caller

post.description: Explicit user retry of failed analysis only. Maximum three claimed attempts including interrupted worker recovery. No automatic retries on AI errors.
